description: A LightningJS component for displaying a list of travel destination cards with scrolling and placeholder states.

methods.name: calcX
methods.description: Calculates the x-position of each destination card based on its index.

methods.name: calcY
methods.description: Calculates the y-position of each destination card based on its index.

methods.name: updateThumb
methods.description: Updates the scrollbar thumb size and position based on current scroll state.

methods.name: recomputeScroll
methods.description: Recalculates scroll constraints when items change or layout updates.

methods.name: $onSelect
methods.description: Handles selection of a destination item.
